📖 How to use

  1. Pick the date you want to classify (defaults to today).
  2. Choose the month your fiscal year starts in.
  3. Read the fiscal year, quarter and exact quarter start/end dates.
  4. See how many days have passed and how many remain in the quarter.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the fiscal year labelled?

By the calendar year in which it ends. With an April start, March 2026 falls in FY2026 (April 2025 – March 2026).

Which start months are common?

January (calendar year), April (UK, Japan, India), July (Australia) and October (US federal government).

How are quarter boundaries found?

Each quarter is exactly 3 calendar months from the fiscal year start: Q1 = months 1–3 of the fiscal year, and so on.
